title: A positive choice from zero is zero
statement: For every natural k: C(0, k+1) = 0.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.zero_choose_succ : ((x0 : AxNat) -> Eq.{1} AxNat (AxNat.choose AxNat.zero (AxNat.succ x0)) AxNat.zero)
